subtitle.en: A BongoCat you can chat with!

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 Music 3（24G）：安装/启停后端、GPU 监视；画布「音乐生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥65GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local Music 3 (24G): install/start backend, GPU monitor, canvas music node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥65GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 YuE2（24G）：歌词 + 风格提示词 → 整曲（人声 + 伴奏），可先出 ABC 乐谱、零样本翻唱；安装/启停后端、GPU 监视；画布「YuE2 音乐生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥30GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local YuE2 (24G): lyrics + style prompt → full song (vocals + accompaniment), optional ABC score planning and zero-shot covers; install/start backend, GPU monitor, canvas YuE2 music node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥30GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】本地 H3 视频（24G）：安装/启停 ComfyUI、GPU 监视；画布「视频生成」节点。安装过程复杂，可能会失败。移除插件不删已装项目。建议预留 ≥70GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Local H3 video (24G): install/start ComfyUI, GPU monitor, canvas video node. Install is complex and may fail. Removing the plugin keeps your install. Reserve ≥70GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 基于 llama.cpp 的本地 GGUF 模型管理：指定目录安装、国内镜像、多模型显存管理、OpenAI 兼容 API。服务不随 MTNode 退出，托盘可手动关闭。
subtitle.en: llama.cpp local GGUF model manager: custom install dir, CN mirrors, multi-model VRAM management, OpenAI-compatible API. Service survives MTNode exit; close via tray.

subtitle.zh: Breeze TTS 2（实时流式 · 音色克隆 / 设计 / 导演）：参考片段音色库、OpenAI 兼容 TTS API（API Key 鉴权）；画布「Breeze 语音」节点。服务不随 MTNode 退出，托盘可手动关闭。权重仅限研究与非商用。
subtitle.en: Breeze TTS 2 (real-time streaming · voice clone / design / direction): reference-clip voice library, OpenAI-compatible TTS API; adds a canvas Breeze voice node. Service survives MTNode exit. Weights are research / non-commercial only.

subtitle.zh: 【插件测试中】让 Agent 直接操作 Blender：从官方 download.blender.org 取最新稳定版便携包（sha256 校验、断点续传）解到你选的目录，装上 mcp-for-blender addon 与 MCP 服务端，并把 MCP 写进 MTNode 的 MCP 配置——重启后 Agent 会话里就有 blender 工具。装完自动跑一次端到端冒烟（启 Blender → addon 端口 → MCP 握手）。已装即跳过、不自动升级；不碰你手开的 Blender。建议预留 ≥1.5GB 磁盘。
subtitle.en: [Testing] Let the agent drive Blender: fetch the latest stable portable build from the official download.blender.org (sha256 verified, resumable) into a folder you pick, install the mcp-for-blender addon and MCP server, and register the MCP entry in MTNode's MCP config — after a restart the agent session has blender tools. An end-to-end smoke runs at the end (launch Blender → addon port → MCP handshake). Existing installs are skipped, no auto-upgrade, and Blender you opened yourself is never touched. Reserve ≥1.5GB disk.

subtitle.zh: 手机 Paseo App 扫码后直接接管 MTNode 的智能体会话：读消息、发消息、插话、终止、替你答审批卡。安装走通用安装窗（优先复用本机已装的 Paseo，没有才装一份自建后端）；自建后端由 MTNode 在后台静默托管（不冒出终端窗口），随 MTNode 退出而停。控制台负责出配对二维码、注册会话接入与远程开关。只碰会话层，不动画布。
subtitle.en: Scan once with the Paseo phone app and take over MTNode agent sessions: read, send, steer mid-turn, stop, and answer the cards that wait for a human. Install runs in the shared install window (it reuses a Paseo already on this machine, and only installs its own copy when there is none); that copy runs silently in the background under MTNode (no terminal window) and stops with MTNode. The console pairs, registers the session provider and toggles remote access. Sessions only — the canvas is never touched.

subtitle.zh: 本地 Remotion（React 动效）视频生成：文本描述 → LLM 生成动效合成 → 渲染 mp4；画布「Remotion 视频」节点。移除插件不删已装项目。
subtitle.en: Local Remotion (React motion) video: text → LLM-generated composition → render mp4; adds a canvas Remotion video node. Removing the plugin keeps your install.

subtitle.zh: 本地数字人视频：一张人物图（或一段源视频）+ 一段语音 → 口型同步 mp4（MeiGen-AI InfiniteTalk，Wan2.1 I2V 14B）。独立装一份 ComfyUI（默认 8199，不复用 H3），权重走 hf-mirror 断点续传；默认开启 fp8 + lightx2v 4 步蒸馏 + SageAttention + 显存水位。插件控制台可安装 / 启停 / 试生成 / 看日志，画布「InfiniteTalk 数字人」节点。长音频由宿主按 81 帧分块续写（下一块接上一块末帧与末 9 帧），分块产物保留可断点续跑；成片直接封入原音轨。需 NVIDIA 显卡（24G 推荐），建议预留 ≥55GB 磁盘。移除插件不删已装项目与产物。
subtitle.en: Local talking-avatar video: one portrait (or a source video) + one voice track → lip-synced mp4 (MeiGen-AI InfiniteTalk on Wan2.1 I2V 14B). It installs its own ComfyUI (port 8199, never reusing H3) and pulls weights from hf-mirror with resume; fp8 + lightx2v 4-step distillation + SageAttention + VRAM headroom are on by default. The console installs, starts/stops, test-generates and shows logs; adds a canvas InfiniteTalk avatar node. Long audio is chunked by the host in 81-frame blocks (each block continues from the previous last frame plus its last 9 frames); finished chunks are kept for resume, and the final mp4 muxes the original audio track. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (24GB recommended) and ≥55GB free disk. Removing the plugin keeps your install and outputs.

subtitle.zh: 本地实时数字人：一张人物图 + 一段语音 → 512×512 @25fps 口型同步 mp4（SoulX-FlashHead Lite 1.3B，Model_Lite 蒸馏 4 步）。整段音频一次流式跑完、不切块；单张 40 系卡即可跑到 25fps 实时（4090 实测高于实时）。默认全开优化：torch.compile + flash-attention（装不上即安装失败）+ SageAttention + fp16 VAE 分片。独立 Python 服务（默认 8198，与 InfiniteTalk 的 8199 隔离），权重走 ModelScope → hf-mirror。插件控制台可安装 / 启停 / 试生成 / 跑实时基准 / 看日志，画布「SoulX 实时数字人」节点。需 NVIDIA 显卡（建议 ≥16G 显存），预留 ≥30GB 磁盘。移除插件不删已装项目与产物。
subtitle.en: Local real-time avatar: one portrait + one voice track → 512×512 @25fps lip-synced mp4 (SoulX-FlashHead Lite 1.3B, Model_Lite 4-step distilled). The whole track runs through in one streaming pass — no host-side chunking — and a single 40-series card reaches 25fps real time (a 4090 measures above real time). All optimizations on by default: torch.compile + flash-attention (installing without it counts as a failure) + SageAttention + fp16 sliced VAE. It runs its own Python service (port 8198, isolated from InfiniteTalk's 8199) and pulls weights from ModelScope, falling back to hf-mirror. The console installs, starts/stops, test-generates, runs a real-time benchmark and shows logs; adds a canvas SoulX real-time avatar node. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (≥16GB VRAM recommended) and ≥30GB free disk. Removing the plugin keeps your install and outputs.

subtitle.zh: 本地 FLUX 3 Image Klein 出图（5.6B 蒸馏 · INT8 默认 / BF16 可选）：独立 ComfyUI（默认 8197）跑官方原生节点，与「图像生成」节点同口径 —— 提示词、多参考图编辑（≤10 张）、比例桶、抽卡 1–10 次 + 种子摇数、蒙版局部重绘、透明背景（双通道差分，抽卡 N 次出 2N 张）。权重走 ModelScope → hf-mirror，也可指定已下载的权重目录。需 NVIDIA 显卡（INT8 8G 起，BF16 建议 24G），预留 ≥40GB 磁盘。许可为 FLUX Kommunity License（年收入 500 万美元以下可商用）。移除插件不删已装项目与产物。
subtitle.en: Local FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B distilled · INT8 default / BF16 optional) on an isolated ComfyUI (port 8197) using the official native nodes, aligned with the image-generation node: prompt, multi-reference editing (≤10), ratio buckets, 1–10 rolls with seed shake, mask inpaint, and transparent background (two-pass difference matte; N rolls yield 2N images). Weights come from ModelScope then hf-mirror, or point it at an already downloaded folder. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (8GB for INT8, 24GB recommended for BF16) and ≥40GB free disk. Licensed under the FLUX Kommunity License (free commercial use under $5M revenue). Removing the plugin keeps your install and outputs.
